# Release v1.2.0: End-to-End Encryption, Secret Chats, User Discovery & Privacy Controls

## What's Changed Since v1.1.0

This release introduces device-bound End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) with dual-mode secret chat tabs, authenticated user discovery with accelerated prefix searching, comprehensive profile privacy controls (invite-only privacy, shareable invite links, custom bios), composite user-IP rate limiting, and an extensive modular decomposition of the TUI client and view layers.

---

### 🔐 End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) & Secret Chat Tabs
* **Device-Bound Cryptographic Identity**:
  - Implemented client-side asymmetric key generation and storage utilizing standard library `crypto/ecdh` (NIST P-256) and AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.
  - Keys are generated locally and securely persisted to device-bound key directories (`~/.tui-chat/keys`).
  - Added public key distribution endpoints (`POST /api/v1/keys` and `GET /api/v1/keys/:user_id`) with authorization and storage layer validations.
  - *(Commits: [`2af0d65`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/2af0d65), [`a281ca2`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/a281ca2), [`d3f54b1`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/d3f54b1), [`e59b1e2`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/e59b1e2))*
* **Dual-Mode Conversations & Secret Chat Tabs**:
  - Added database migration `20261012190000_add_conversation_is_secret.sql` introducing `is_secret` flag for conversations.
  - Integrated secret chat tabs into the TUI, allowing users to toggle between regular and encrypted secret conversations with the same recipient.
  - Extracted reusable `DecryptMessage` and `FindChatByConvID` helpers to decouple decryption from view rendering.
  - Added robust decryption safeguards and fallback handling in `FetchMessages` and `FetchChats` to handle unencrypted legacy messages or mismatched credentials gracefully.
  - Fixed E2EE key rotation handling in the sidebar and prevented session 401 refresh loops during key verification.
  - *(Commits: [`de241eb`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/de241eb), [`e5bb272`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/e5bb272), [`63e3237`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/63e3237), [`32d9005`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/32d9005))*

---

### 🔍 Authenticated User Discovery & Direct Messaging
* **Username Discovery API**:
  - Implemented authenticated `GET /api/v1/users/search?q=...` with case-insensitive prefix matching, self-exclusion, and strict result limits.
  - Added PostgreSQL migration `20261006212029_add_idx_users_lower_username_pattern.sql` creating a `varchar_pattern_ops` B-tree index on `LOWER(username)` for accelerated prefix lookups.
  - Hardened direct conversation creation and lookups to reliably return existing conversations and prevent duplicates.
  - *(Commits: [`b763460`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/b763460), [`184ee82`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/184ee82), [`e1e8470`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/e1e8470), [`c815ed0`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/c815ed0))*
* **TUI Discovery Modal & Direct Message Routing**:
  - Built interactive discovery modal (`internal/tui/discovery.go`) allowing users to search active users by username prefix and launch direct conversations directly from the terminal.
  - Redesigned New DM modal with responsive width framing, search input, and onboarding prompts.
  - Added client discovery methods and connected direct messaging initiation with server-backed routing.
  - *(Commits: [`35fb16f`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/35fb16f), [`c94d8ff`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/c94d8ff))*

---

### 🛡️ Profile Management, Privacy Controls & Invite Links
* **User Bio, Invite-Only Privacy & Link Sharing**:
  - Added database migration `20261027220833_add_user_bio_and_search_privacy.sql` introducing `bio`, `is_searchable` privacy flag, and unique `invite_token`.
  - Added profile endpoints: `GET /api/v1/users/me`, `PUT /api/v1/users/me`, `POST /api/v1/users/me/invite-token` (token regeneration), and `GET /api/v1/users/invite/:token`.
  - Enforced privacy protections: users who set `is_searchable = false` are hidden from public discovery, and new direct conversations cannot be initiated without their specific invite token or a pre-existing conversation.
  - *(Commit: [`5a85b2e`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/5a85b2e))*
* **Interactive Profile TUI & Bio Previews**:
  - Redesigned Profile view with interactive privacy toggle (Searchable vs. Invite-Only), invite link display, one-touch clipboard copy, and token regeneration.
  - Displayed recipient bio previews in chat headers, profile view, and user discovery search results.
  - *(Commit: [`5a85b2e`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/5a85b2e))*

---

### ⚡ API Security & Session Hardening
* **Composite User-IP Rate Limiting**:
  - Implemented `CompositeUserIPRateLimiter` middleware combining authenticated user ID and client IP to prevent brute-force attacks and rate limit evasion.
  - Consolidated handler context assertions for reliable user identification across routes.
  - *(Commit: [`961c3ec`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/961c3ec))*
* **JWT Claims & Session Lifecycle Fixes**:
  - Unified JWT token username extraction and claims parsing across auth and WebSocket flows.
  - Safeguarded client HTTP session management against infinite 401 redirect/refresh loops.
  - *(Commit: [`32d9005`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/32d9005))*

---

### 🧱 Modular Architecture & Codebase Refactoring
* **HTTP Client Domain Modularization**:
  - Decomposed monolithic `internal/tui/client/http_client.go` into domain modules: `auth.go`, `chats.go`, `discovery.go`, `keys.go`, `messages.go`, `session.go`, and `ws.go`.
  - *(Commit: [`0a3f386`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/0a3f386))*
* **TUI View Decomposition**:
  - Decomposed `views/chat/chat.go` into focused components: `input.go`, `messages.go`, `render.go`, and `types.go`.
  - Decomposed `views/auth/auth.go` into focused components: `forms.go`, `errors.go`, `mouse.go`, and `render.go`.
  - *(Commits: [`76e7f8d`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/76e7f8d), [`1c7e304`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/1c7e304))*
* **Test Suite Hygiene**:
  - Pruned redundant, duplicate, and tautological test assertions across TUI and API suites.
  - Added unit and integration tests for keys API, discovery endpoints, profile privacy, chat tabs, and E2EE workflows.
  - *(Commits: [`241ebcd`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/241ebcd), [`c815ed0`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/c815ed0), [`e59b1e2`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/e59b1e2))*

---

### 📖 Documentation & Setup
* Added `.env.example` with clear environment variable documentation.
* Updated installation instructions with versioned binary downloads and documented `Tab` and `Ctrl+S` navigation shortcuts.
* Updated project `README.md` with comprehensive feature documentation, architectural diagrams, and keybinding references.
* *(Commits: [`c411ff7`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/c411ff7), [`a525ee4`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/a525ee4), [`6416179`](https://github.com/DanielJohn17/tui-chat/commit/6416179))*
